- configurable: error OR fallback to stagnant_film

km must accept scalar or spatial fields and return km aligned to domain grid.

tasks.title: Rate laws (powerlaw + saturation/inhibition) with apparent order diagnostics
tasks.description:

- powerlaw: r = k(T) * Π Cs_i^n_i (allow negative/fractional n)
- saturation_inhibition: denominator form enabling order transitions and inhibition

Implement:
- stable log evaluation
- apparent order computation n_app = d ln r / d ln C (analytical if possible)

Ensure rate laws accept Cs dict + state + T arrays.
acceptance_criteria: Rate law registry resolves model by name from config
powerlaw supports negative/fractional orders robustly
apparent_orders returns maps consistent with analytical expectations for these models

tasks.title: Transport–reaction coupling solver: vectorized bisection on progress variable R
tasks.description:
Implement the core coupled solver for the single-dominant-reaction case:

- Reduce to scalar root solve F(R)=0 with physical bracket [0, R_max]
- Provide vectorized bisection solver (NumPy baseline)
- Track iteration counts and status flags per grid point

Add monotonicity/shape check for F(R):
- detect potential non-monotonic cases (sample points)
- define fallback behavior (warn + optional interval split OR controlled failure)

Ensure C_s is computed from R and clipped/guarded to nonnegative values for forward sim.
acceptance_criteria: solve_progress_R returns R, Cs, iteration_count, status_map
Nonnegativity constraints are enforced (Cs>=0, R within bracket)
Monotonicity check exists and produces an explicit status/warning

- builds km via mass-transfer model

- computes deposition rate and thickness for process_time

Must output standard diagnostics:
- thickness map
- Cs/Cref map(s)
- Da proxy (define and document)
- apparent order maps (from RateLaw)
- root iteration counts/status
acceptance_criteria: run_cvd_steady returns thickness + diagnostics as arrays aligned with domain grid
Diagnostics include Cs/Cref, Da proxy, apparent orders, solver health
